field.name: note
field.p:
1. Payment Terms
Fifty percent (50%) of the total order value is payable in advance upon order confirmation. The remaining balance shall be settled prior to delivery, following notification that the products are ready.

2. Warranty
12 months or 1,000 running hours, whichever occurs first, from the date of delivery. Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) are available on request.

3. Taxes
Prices in the UAE are subject to VAT at 5%. Export prices are VAT 0%; import duties and taxes in the country of destination are borne by the Customer.

4. Validity
This offer is valid for 30 days. Due to the continuous changes in the prices of the materials and components we purchase, resulting from current market conditions, we are unable to hold prices for a longer period.

5. Scope
Freight, installation, testing & commissioning are not included and will be quoted after approval. ATS panels and fuel tanks are available on request.

p.em: In line with continuous product development, we reserve the right to modify specifications without prior notice, ensuring an equal or superior level of quality and efficiency.
